// Fixture for the saveactions lint: Save calls without actions.
// Should produce 2 findings (the pragma'd one is exempted).
//
// Stored as .go.txt so the lint reads it as raw source via
// parser.ParseFile but `go build` doesn't try to compile it.
package fixtures

import "github.com/gramaton-ai/gramaton/graph"

type engineLike struct{}

func (e *engineLike) Save(message string, actions ...graph.CommitAction) error { return nil }
func (e *engineLike) SaveOrLog(message string, actions ...graph.CommitAction)  {}

func MissingAction(e *engineLike) {
	_ = e.Save("op")
}

func MissingActionSaveOrLog(e *engineLike) {
	e.SaveOrLog("op")
}

func PragmaExempted(e *engineLike) {
	//gramaton:saveactions:exempt
	_ = e.Save("op")
}
